_comment: Pinned Stockfish release and the SHA-256 of every asset we may download.
Digests come from the GitHub release API, so the binary is verified before
it is ever executed. sf_18 is pinned on purpose: it is the last release with
prebuilt binaries for both Windows (local dev) and Linux (containers), and a
cached evaluation is only valid for the engine version that produced it.
See INTERVIEW_PREP.md for the full reasoning.
preference: tried in order; the first binary that passes a UCI smoke test
wins. AVX-VNNI is fastest on Alder Lake and newer Intel, but is absent on
older server CPUs such as the Ice Lake parts GitHub Actions runs, so a
fallback chain is required. Keys must be platform names only - the fetch
